# Wallaby Agent Development installers

Current: **V2 Development Build 10**, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS amd64.

Install `wallaby-agent_2.0.0~dev10_amd64.deb` with your normal package manager. Existing service settings are retained. New installations start with all tunnels off.

Verify SHA256SUMS.txt before installation. Earlier installers remain here for historical use; source at the matching commit is linked in the main README. This is Development, not a Stable release. Read VALIDATION.md for machine and optical-hardware validation limits.
